en:
No admission of guilt nor any sign of remorse. Okay. You had
your chance. What do you say we call the police?
I'm not lyin', I'm tellin' ya... Look! There he is!

That's him! He's the real stalker! I see him wanderin'
around Haruka-chan's apartment all the time!
...You're serious?
See? There he goes! He's the stalker! Ya gotta believe me!
What? Damn it! Why do they always have to run!?

Man, they've got me running all over town... So, pal, tell
me⑬are you the real stalker?

Stalker? Ya got it all wrong! I was hopin' to protect
Haruka-chan...

Oh, geez, not you, too. Fine, we'll let the police sort
this out.

Wait, wait, wait! I really ain't your stalker! Look over
there! There he is!
Ah!

Don't try to pretend you're not, ya creep! I seen ya
stakin' out Haruka-chan's apartment plenty of times!

You take that back! I ain't no stalker! I'll have you know
I been keepin' Haruka-chan safe!
Hey, mellow out. What's going on here?
Hell if I know! Where do you get off callin' me a stalker!?

I'm gonna keep Haruka-chan safe from the likes of you
assholes! Say your prayers!
Hiya, Yamaura-san. How's Haruka-chan?

Oh, hi, Akiyama-san. Actually, I was hopin' to talk to you
about her.

Our agency has neither the staff nor the money to keep watch
over Haruka 24/7, you know?

Since we're up here, she'll be fine. But we're headin' back
down to Osaka after her concert, so it's not exactly
something we can just ignore.
I'd have to agree.

In that case, I was wondering⑬if you ever go back to
Sotenbori, do you think you could take a look around
Haruka's apartment building? You know, when you have time.
Hey! Hey, you! Hold it right there!
Hmm? Me?

Yeah, you! Who do you think!? You're Haruka Sawamura, aren't
you?
Yes, that's right. Um... Do I know you?

What!? You're trying to be a top idol, and you don't even
know who I am!?

I'm Ulala, the daughter of the legendary beauty from the
neighboring town.
Um, so your mother is a legendary beauty?

My mother is, and I am, too! They always told me I'd be
beautiful when I grew up, and, as you can plainly see, I am!

But if you think you can be an idol around here and not know
who I am, you've got another thing coming! We idols are very
particular, you know!
I'm very sorry. I still have a lot to learn...

Exactly! And don't you think you've been letting your
success go to your head lately?

You're not even that cute, but you suddenly get a few fans,
and now you're all full of yourself!
Show-offs like you make me absolutely sick!
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to come across that way.

I've seen you, with that snooty, smug look on your face,
twisting and gyrating all over the stage, doing those dance battles or whatever you call them!

Hmph! You should be downright embarrassed, if you ask me! A
potato'd make a better dancer than you!

Um, I'm not sure what I did wrong, but I'm sorry if I did
something to upset you.
Truly, I am.
Ha! One itty-bitty apology isn't going to cut it, sister!

I came all this way to Sotenbori, only to find everybody
making a big fuss over a little nothing like you!? What a
joke!

What do you call those thingies again? Dance battles? Okay
then, let's see you do one right now! I, the great Ulala,
will be your opponent!
What? You want to have a dance battle with me?

That's right! What, is there something wrong with your
hearing, too!?

Ooh, you make me so mad! Hmph. But that's all right. You'll
get yours when I completely annihilate you in front of
everybody!

Unless you're too scared to take me on, that is? I mean,
who could blame you for thinking you're no match for the
great Ulala?
All right. You're on.
Great. Just try not to cry when I beat you!

Well, I'd love to, but I'm afraid I'm a little busy right
now.

Yeah, right! Some excuse that is... Whatever! I'll be here
waiting if you ever work up enough courage.

Ha! You're back! Ready to get pulverized in our dance
battle!?

Well, you've got guts, I'll give you that much. Just try not
to cry when I beat you!

I lost!? After the performance I just gave!? How could I
have lost!?

Grr! How could a little stick like you possibly beat me!? It
doesn't make any sense!

I've worked so hard on my wardrobe and my diet so I could
become a top idol! Do you have any idea what I've been
through!?
Um... No, but⑬

Now I'm hungry! And it's all your fault! I'm gonna go get
some takoyaki. You wait right there!

Mmm, that was good! I had three helpings because of you!
Thanks for that!
Three helpings? But I thought you were trying to diet?

Shut up! Who asked you!? What I really wanted to have was
cake, but I stopped myself. But what would you know!? You
could never understand!

Oh, no! What time is it!? The T-shirt sale at the
supermarket is just about to end! They're on sale for only
500 yen each!
If I miss that sale, it'll be all your fault!

Wait a minute. When you said you've been working hard on
your wardrobe, did you mean bargain T-shirts?

When there's a supermarket sale, you have to go in prepared
for battle! They're serious business!

That may be true, but a bargain T-shirt isn't really what
most people would call "fashionable," don't you think?

You've got something to say about everything, don't you,
little stick girl!?

I'll get my revenge on you! Just you wait! You'd better
enjoy your life while you still can!
Wow. Ulala sure is something...
You got 2,500 experience points.

Ha! You lose! As expected! I told you a potato could dance
better than you!
Wait a minute! Something was off about that battle...
I think the smaller girl danced better!
What's that!? You all got something to say!?

Fine! If the peanut gallery doesn't agree that I won, then
I'll just do it again! I'll crush this girl as many times as you like!

You hear that, Haruka!? You'd better come back so I can
prove to the crowd once again that I'm the best! I'll be
waiting for you!
What am I going to do? I'm stumped.
(What's this wacky getup? A street performer or somethin'?)
Sorry, sir. I'm not performing right now.
Ya sure about that? Way you're dressed, I'm expectin' you to squirt water out of a flower any second.
I just met with the festival organizers. I haven't had a chance to change.
Whatever. You take care.
Wait, stay a moment!
Eh?
You came to see the snow festival, didn't you? Can I get your opinion on something?
Depends. On what?
My name's Inari. I was invited to add a little pizzazz to the festival.
So I put together a few acts to show the organizers...
And they didn't like any of it! They want me to do something with a local bent. Something that fits the snow festival theme.
A street performance with a snow festival theme? What the hell would that be?
Exactly! I have no idea!
Snow is white. Maybe something white? White sugar? I could bake a cake... while juggling!
Argh, that's stupid. And I'm running out of time!
So you're askin' random passersby for ideas?
I thought a visitor might have a fresh perspective on the snow festival.
Not me. I ain't even here for the snow festival.
Oh? I just assumed... I'm quite sorry.
It's fine. Look, I feel for ya, but I ain't exactly a guy who thinks up candy-ass festival ideas.
Sure... But hey, if you see anything around here that inspires you, come back and tell me.
I'm not trying to enlist you! Just, please, if you happen to be struck by an idea, I'd love to hear it.
You're some kinda desperate. All right. If I find somethin' interesting I'll let ya know.
Thank you! I'll be right here, racking my brains!
(Snow festival theme, huh? These snow statues gotta be it. Might as well have a look at 'em.)
If you were struck by any ideas for a street performance with a snow festival theme, I'd be grateful to hear them.
(Snow festival, huh? These snow statues gotta be part of that. Might as well have a look at 'em.)
Oh, hello! It's no good. I can't come up with any ideas.
You really a performer? Ya'd think a pro could come up with somethin'.
You're right... I should just quit. That would be better for everyone...
Hey, not so fast. Come on... ya gotta show a little more fight than that.
Easy for you to say.
Well, I did find somethin' that might help ya.
Really!? What is it?
Whaddaya think of a snowman?
A snowman...?
Yeah. Ya see the big snowman over there? Why doncha roll giant snowballs by riding on top of 'em, and make a huge snowman?
Ride giant snowballs and make a snowman?
I love that! I'm going with it!
You're gonna use my idea just like that? Did ya even do any thinkin' of your own?
Of course I did! I thought about it so hard I forgot all my good ideas.
But yours is so much better, anyway. You even cleverly incorporated the fact that I'm an expert ball-rider. I tip my hat to you, sir!
Eh? I didn't incorporate nothin'. How can you be an expert at ball⑬
Okay! I need to practice! Oh, I know! I'll do more than just ride the snowball. I'll juggle at the same time!
Wow! You listening to this? Ideas are pouring out of me now!
Pouring out of you? All ya did was add juggling.
Don't get hung up on the details. Anyway, thank you so much! You're my savior!
I'll put together a new act, and I hope you'll come see it!
If I got time.
Ooh, yeah! I'm going to be a star!
(Not sure how that's gonna go, but at least the fella's happy.)
You got 1,500 experience points.

Oh, hiya! Can I interest you in some okonomiyaki? No
foolin', they're real good!

I have to admit, it does smell great. But, uh, aren't all
okonomiyaki from stalls pretty much the same?

Hey, now, those are fightin' words. No, we keep it real. We
take the time to get things right, from sourcing the flour
to the final prep.

It's downright heartbreakin' to hear you lumpin' us all
together with the usual street fare.

Is that right? Well, let's see you back up your claim. I'll
try one.
Thank you! I'll grill one up fresh and hot. Hang tight now.
Here ya go!
Thanks. Best served hot, right?
Hm, hm... Whoa!

You weren't kidding, this is good! This stuff puts
restaurants to shame.

Absolutely. I'm confident in what I sell. Only trouble is
that lot over there've been takin' all my business. I'm
really hurtin' here.
Hi! Come on over!
Fresh okonomiyaki to go, right here!
And that charming pair over there?
They're yakuza goons who run things around here.

Whenever we get customers, they cause trouble to scare them
off.
Classic...
Huh? Hey...
Yo, Yasuo, what's up? Got yourself a customer?
Nice goin'. Business's been a little slow lately, huh?

What's it to you? Our okonomiyaki's better than the crap
you're servin'. Ain't no wonder customers choose us over
you.
Ya can talk the talk, I'll give ya that.

But hey, Yasuo, wrap your head around this. What happens if
rumors start spreadin'? Drop money at Yasuo's place, and a
coupla scary folks'll kick your ass.

What!? Don't ya dare! The customers ain't got nothin' to do
with this.

They got everythin' to do with this, dipshit! Folks who
can't appreciate good food need to be shown the error of their ways.

See, pal, we got no personal axe to grind with ya, but we
gotta thump ya. Just good business, ya know? No hard
feelings.

Haha... That's some business model you've got there. You
don't actually believe that, do you?

You're a man of reason. I like that. But this is our
territory, so we make the rules. Whatever we do, that's
justice, see?

So, let's get this over with, pal. Remember, if ya wanna
thank someone for your bumps and bruises, you can thank Yasuo.
Ow, fuck, owww... Who the hell are you? You're a monster.

Sorry to disappoint, but I'm just a passing customer. Nice
to see you fellows are so committed to your job, but learn
to pick your fights better, all right?
Tch... This ain't over!
Sorry about that. I shouldn't be causing a scene in front of your place.

Oh, no problem at all. That was a heck of a display. Say,
whaddya call that style of yours? You kicked those goons
around like they were sacks of rice.
Huh? Oh, yeah. Might've gotten a little carried away...

No, you were awesome! You really inspired me. If it were me
puttin' on an acrobatic spectacle like that, people'd come
from miles around to see what I'm cookin'.
Mister, what's your name?
Huh? I'm Akiyama.

Akiyama-han, just you watch, I'm gonna be the Akiyama-han of
the okonomiyaki world!

I already got the flavor down. All's I need now is a
showstoppin' performance that'll capture the hearts and
minds of the customers!
